session_summary: Diagnosed and fixed the recurring 'aggressive micro-agent dispatch + committer git-environment' failures. code-analyst root-caused it (mining reflections per user instruction) to the host ~/.gitconfig bind-mounted READ-ONLY onto the container global-config path (src/index.js), causing EBUSY 'Device or resource busy' on all global git writes (git config --global, gh auth setup-git, ghBootstrap) → committer warnings, false max_turns failures, and ~10-min busy-lock hangs that masqueraded as dispatch failures. User hypothesis B (shared gitconfig) CONFIRMED across 4-5 reflections (2026-06-17/18/22, 2026-07-06-unity); hypothesis A (socket-proxy) REFUTED (proxy already fail-safed). harness-engineer shipped v3.20.1 (commit 78c7198): mount host gitconfig RO at /etc/voltron/host.gitconfig + writable GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL with an [include] of the host file. Committed + pushed to fable-eval-prereqs. Fix requires Claude Code restart (MCP server, no hot-reload) to take effect. Not yet deployed to main.

agent_feedback.worked_well: Given two competing user hypotheses (proxy vs shared gitconfig), it tested BOTH and returned clear verdicts (B confirmed with reflection counts + file:line, A refuted with the fail-safe evidence), plus an exact single fix target and a note that the same root cause explained the 'dispatch hang' symptom. Mining reflections as explicitly requested surfaced the frequency signal.

Implemented the non-trivial container-plumbing fix precisely (non-global mount + GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL + idempotent include seed run before ghBootstrap), preserved the repo-local identity safety net and proxy logic, self-validated all 5 checks, and gave a clean before/after of the mount line.
Explicit 4-path staging kept the commit scoped to the fix despite untracked reflections and hook-modified .claude files present.

overall_notes: KEY GOTCHA for future sessions: symptoms attributed to 'micro-agent dispatch' or 'the proxy' were actually the read-only gitconfig mount causing git EBUSY busy-lock hangs — a reminder to check container git-env before blaming the dispatcher. The scrum-master's own div-guidance and proxy fail-safe were fine. Also: fixes to src/index.js (the MCP server) do NOT hot-reload — they require a Claude Code restart, so this session's fix is committed/pushed but not yet live. Recorded the generic lesson to Alexandria (reference: docker-gitconfig-readonly-mount-ebusy) and a project-specific note to beads memory (voltron-container-gitconfig-ebusy-fix). Tools touched: Docker bind mounts, git config --global, gh auth setup-git, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL.
